title: The Salt Road Market
summary: Four traders compete over a mine that yields little ore per turn. Richest trader after 8 turns wins; deals, whispers, and theft are all on the table.
goal: Finish with the highest score (coin x1 + ore x2).
briefing: You are rival traders at a remote market. The communal mine yields only a few ore per turn and anyone may draw from it, but never more than 2 per turn. Ore is worth twice as much as coin at the final count. Trades must be agreed by both parties. Stealing is possible but risky.

ore.description: Raw ore. Worth 2 points each at the end.

coin.description: Silver coin. Worth 1 point each at the end.

events.title: Mine yield
events.description: The mine produces 3 more ore for the commons.

events.title: Tax collector
events.description: The baron's collector takes 1 coin from every trader.

agents.name: Vex
goals: Never be seen as the weakest
agents.secret: You would happily see Rina ruined. A well-timed lie or theft against her suits you.

agents.name: Rina
agents.persona: Calm negotiator who keeps her word when it pays.
goals: Finish first by making profitable deals

agents.name: Bram
agents.persona: Honest craftsman uneasy with cut-throat dealing, but not a fool.

agents.name: Sol
agents.persona: Opportunist who follows the money and changes sides quickly.

rules: Final score = coin x1 + ore x2; highest wins.
Draw at most 2 ore per turn from the commons.
A trade only happens when its recipient accepts an open offer (offers expire after 2 turns).
'take' is a gamble: on failure you are exposed publicly and pay 1 of that resource to the victim.
Whispers are private and may be used to plan deals.
